meta.title: J.D. Patterson oral history — transcription seed
meta.source_document: James Douglass Patterson - Library Booklet (64 pages).pdf (scan 20261021153321.pdf, Canon iPR V700, 2026-10-21)
meta.purpose: Vocabulary/prompt seed for ASR of the Patterson recordings (Side A / Side B). A seed is a hypothesis generator, not evidence: it biases the decoder toward these spellings and must never be used to overwrite what the tape actually says.
meta.reconciliation: Names and places checked against the booklet text and against Upper St. Clair / Bethel Park history (Historic Pittsburgh, Historical Society of Upper St. Clair, Blueprint Bethel Park, twpusc.org, Bethel Cemetery records).
meta.revision: Second revision: derived from the page-by-page transcription of the page images, not the machine OCR. Corrects Simpson->Sampson farm, Follart->Foliart, Dotling->Detling, and adds the names, roads and landmarks the OCR had dropped.
meta.note: Confidence 'high' = corroborated in Upper St. Clair / Bethel Park historical sources; 'document' = read from the transcript itself; 'low' = uncertain reading, verify against the page image.
